description: Point-in-time seed for V6-B Radar dynamic universe. This file is not enough for historical backtest before 2026-05-10; it defines the format and current live-forward pool.

entries.reason: First-order AI accelerator leader; missed by earlier Radar priority design despite strong momentum and estimate revision relevance.
entries.anti_thesis: AI accelerator growth or margin trajectory fails to validate; momentum breaks without fundamental revision support.

entries.reason: AI networking / fabric leader candidate; direct beneficiary of data-center scale-out.
entries.anti_thesis: AI networking order momentum slows or valuation embeds too much forward growth.

entries.reason: High-quality AI manufacturing anchor; strong ecosystem position.
entries.anti_thesis: AI wafer demand or advanced-node pricing deteriorates; geopolitical risk dominates.

entries.reason: HBM / memory cycle beneficiary; potential second-order AI infrastructure repricing.
entries.anti_thesis: HBM supply expands faster than demand or pricing power normalizes.

entries.reason: AI data storage / HDD roadmap / storage-cycle repricing candidate.
entries.anti_thesis: Storage pricing, demand, or AI data growth narrative fails to translate into earnings.

entries.reason: Turnaround momentum candidate driven by policy, capital structure, foundry cycle, or semiconductor beta.
entries.anti_thesis: Turnaround milestones fail; revenue/profit inflection does not appear; capital intensity overwhelms recovery narrative.

entries.reason: Advanced packaging watch candidate; requires stronger AI/HPC customer and revenue evidence.
entries.anti_thesis: No clear AI/HPC advanced-packaging revenue validation.

entries.reason: Edge AI expectation-gap candidate; low coverage but slower validation path.
entries.anti_thesis: Edge AI design wins do not convert to material revenue acceleration.

entries.reason: Edge AI IP small-cap candidate; optionality but limited immediate proof.
entries.anti_thesis: IP licensing cycle remains slow or market ignores the theme.
